meta.title: Navara, an open-source 3D map engine
meta.description: Navara is a highly extensible 3D map engine. Load GIS data, from satellite imagery and terrain to 3D city models and vector data, then layer your own visualizations on top.

hero.posterAlt: The Navara promotion video, diving from orbit onto a 3D globe

intro.copyHtml: Navara is a highly extensible 3D map engine. Load a wide range of GIS data, from satellite imagery and terrain to 3D city models and vector data, then freely layer your own visualizations on top. Start with declarative styling, add advanced features with plugins, and go further with custom representations tailored to your application's needs.

values.title: High quality, instantly
values.desc: Create beautiful scenes with just a few lines of code.

values.title: Yours to control
values.desc: Fine-tune a wide range of effects down to the smallest detail.

values.title: Extending is just the start
values.desc: A flexible foundation for building, extending, and reusing your own visualizations.

values.title: Built to last
values.desc: A renderer-agnostic architecture powered by Rust and WebAssembly, with WebGPU and native support planned.

apiLede.title: Declarative and extensible.
apiLede.sub: Extend it your way with plugins, APIs, and shaders.

apiSegments.label: Declarative
apiSegments.scene: Add 3D Tiles, terrain, and a basemap declaratively.
apiSegments.desc: Declare layers and materials as config objects to visualize GIS data.

apiSegments.label: Plugin
apiSegments.scene: Use DefaultPlugin to add atmosphere, sun, clouds, and shadows all at once.
apiSegments.desc: Add purpose-built features as plugins with ease, and reuse complex functionality.

apiSegments.label: API
apiSegments.scene: Every building evaluated by measured height, colored per feature.
apiSegments.desc: Flexibly drive feature evaluation, picking, geodesy, and camera control.

apiSegments.label: Shader
apiSegments.scene: Use a FogLight shader to add a nighttime look.
apiSegments.desc: Full access to Three.js for your own shaders and effects.

arch.diagramAlt: Architecture diagram: Rust / WASM parses data and builds geometry, and its output is drawn by Three.js today, with other engines and Native tomorrow.

gallery.h2: GIS that stands as a picture.

maplibre.h2: Your styles and tiles, straight to 3D.
maplibre.copy: MapLibre, together with its open-source community, shaped modern web mapping. Navara is open source too (MIT / Apache-2.0), and it extends that mapping into 3D.
items: Supports MapLibre styles (MapLibre Style Plugin, in development), so you can reuse your existing MapLibre assets as-is.
Support planned for MapLibre Tile (MLT), the next-generation format.
